name: exploded-portafilter-mistral-large-4-0-s2-r1
prompt: Draw an exploded assembly diagram of an espresso machine portafilter, as an SVG. Use a double-spout portafilter with a removable basket rather than a bottomless one.

source.text:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1000 650" width="1000" height="650">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="metal" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#f8fafc"/>
      <stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#c3cad2"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#eef1f4"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="metalDark" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#d7dde3"/>
      <stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#9aa3ad"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#c9d0d7"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="metalBasket" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#f1f4f7"/>
      <stop offset="0.55" stop-color="#b9c1ca"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#e6eaee"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="wood" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#b07a45"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#8a5a2b"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <marker id="arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="8" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#475569"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>

  <!-- background -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="1000" height="650" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <rect x="10" y="10" width="980" height="630" rx="12" fill="none" stroke="#e5e7eb" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- title -->
  <text x="500" y="36" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="26" font-weight="bold" fill="#111827">Exploded Assembly Diagram</text>
  <text x="500" y="59" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#4b5563">Double-spout portafilter with removable basket</text>

  <!-- assembly axis (dashed centerline) -->
  <line x1="500" y1="70" x2="500" y2="600" stroke="#94a3b8" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="7 7"/>

  <!-- ============ PART 1: HANDLE ============ -->
  <g stroke-linejoin="round">
    <rect x="487" y="128" width="26" height="18" fill="#aeb6bf" stroke="#6b7280" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="487" y1="134" x2="513" y2="134" stroke="#6b7280" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="487" y1="140" x2="513" y2="140" stroke="#6b7280" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="470" y="106" width="60" height="22" rx="4" fill="url(#metal)" stroke="#6b7280" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="375" y="70" width="250" height="36" rx="18" fill="url(#wood)" stroke="#5f3c17" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="388" y="76" width="224" height="9" rx="4.5" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.25"/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="345" cy="88" r="14" fill="#111827"/>
    <text x="345" y="92.5" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff">1</text>
  </g>

  <!-- ============ PART 2: PORTAFILTER BODY ============ -->
  <g stroke-linejoin="round">
    <!-- bayonet lugs -->
    <rect x="318" y="232" width="44" height="26" rx="6" fill="url(#metalDark)" stroke="#6b7280" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="638" y="232" width="44" height="26" rx="6" fill="url(#metalDark)" stroke="#6b7280" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <!-- body -->
    <path d="M350,206 L395,294 Q500,314 605,294 L650,206 Z" fill="url(#metal)" stroke="#6b7280" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <!-- bottom opening (basket seat) -->
    <ellipse cx="500" cy="298" rx="104" ry="12" fill="#8f97a1" stroke="#6b7280" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="500" cy="298" rx="86" ry="9" fill="#6f7780"/>
    <!-- top rim -->
    <ellipse cx="500" cy="206" rx="150" ry="20" fill="#e8ecf0" stroke="#6b7280" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="500" cy="206" rx="120" ry="13" fill="#9aa3ad"/>
    <ellipse cx="500" cy="206" rx="100" ry="10" fill="#7d8590"/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="290" cy="245" r="14" fill="#111827"/>
    <text x="290" y="249.5" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff">2</text>
  </g>

  <!-- ============ PART 3: REMOVABLE BASKET ============ -->
  <g stroke-linejoin="round">
    <!-- tapered wall -->
    <path d="M404,356 L446,426 Q500,442 554,426 L596,356 Z" fill="url(#metalBasket)" stroke="#6b7280" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <!-- perforations on lower wall -->
    <g fill="#5b6470">
      <circle cx="446" cy="402" r="2"/><circle cx="464" cy="402" r="2"/><circle cx="482" cy="402" r="2"/><circle cx="500" cy="402" r="2"/><circle cx="518" cy="402" r="2"/><circle cx="536" cy="402" r="2"/><circle cx="554" cy="402" r="2"/>
      <circle cx="450" cy="415" r="2"/><circle cx="468" cy="415" r="2"/><circle cx="486" cy="415" r="2"/><circle cx="504" cy="415" r="2"/><circle cx="522" cy="415" r="2"/><circle cx="540" cy="415" r="2"/>
    </g>
    <!-- bottom with perforations -->
    <ellipse cx="500" cy="430" rx="54" ry="9" fill="#cfd5db" stroke="#6b7280" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <g fill="#5b6470">
      <circle cx="458" cy="427" r="2.2"/><circle cx="473" cy="427" r="2.2"/><circle cx="488" cy="427" r="2.2"/><circle cx="503" cy="427" r="2.2"/><circle cx="518" cy="427" r="2.2"/><circle cx="533" cy="427" r="2.2"/><circle cx="548" cy="427" r="2.2"/>
      <circle cx="455" cy="430" r="2.2"/><circle cx="470" cy="430" r="2.2"/><circle cx="485" cy="430" r="2.2"/><circle cx="500" cy="430" r="2.2"/><circle cx="515" cy="430" r="2.2"/><circle cx="530" cy="430" r="2.2"/><circle cx="545" cy="430" r="2.2"/>
      <circle cx="458" cy="433" r="2.2"/><circle cx="473" cy="433" r="2.2"/><circle cx="488" cy="433" r="2.2"/><circle cx="503" cy="433" r="2.2"/><circle cx="518" cy="433" r="2.2"/><circle cx="533" cy="433" r="2.2"/><circle cx="548" cy="433" r="2.2"/>
    </g>
    <!-- rim -->
    <ellipse cx="500" cy="356" rx="96" ry="12" fill="#e8ecf0" stroke="#6b7280" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="500" cy="356" rx="78" ry="7.5" fill="#a9b1ba"/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="392" cy="386" r="14" fill="#111827"/>
    <text x="392" y="390.5" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff">3</text>
  </g>

  <!-- ============ PART 4: DOUBLE-SPOUT OUTLET ============ -->
  <g stroke-linejoin="round">
    <rect x="460" y="504" width="80" height="14" fill="url(#metalDark)" stroke="#6b7280" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <!-- left spout -->
    <path d="M462,518 L490,518 L483,560 Q476,566 469,560 Z" fill="url(#metalDark)" stroke="#6b7280" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <!-- right spout -->
    <path d="M510,518 L538,518 L531,560 Q524,566 517,560 Z" fill="url(#metalDark)" stroke="#6b7280" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <!-- spout outlets -->
    <ellipse cx="476" cy="561" rx="5" ry="2.5" fill="#4b5563"/>
    <ellipse cx="524" cy="561" rx="5" ry="2.5" fill="#4b5563"/>
    <!-- top plate -->
    <ellipse cx="500" cy="504" rx="72" ry="10" fill="#dfe4ea" stroke="#6b7280" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="396" cy="530" r="14" fill="#111827"/>
    <text x="396" y="534.5" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff">4</text>
  </g>

  <!-- ============ assembly direction arrows ============ -->
  <g stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none">
    <line x1="500" y1="152" x2="500" y2="178" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
    <line x1="500" y1="318" x2="500" y2="340" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
    <line x1="500" y1="448" x2="500" y2="490" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
  </g>
  <text x="514" y="170" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="11.5" fill="#475569">assemble downward</text>

  <!-- ============ labels with leader lines ============ -->
  <g font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#111827">
    <text x="718" y="93">Handle</text>
    <text x="718" y="250">Portafilter body with bayonet lugs</text>
    <text x="718" y="391">Removable basket (perforated)</text>
    <text x="718" y="535">Double-spout outlet</text>
  </g>
  <g stroke="#6b7280" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none">
    <line x1="712" y1="88" x2="630" y2="88"/>
    <line x1="712" y1="245" x2="688" y2="245"/>
    <line x1="712" y1="386" x2="582" y2="386"/>
    <line x1="712" y1="530" x2="542" y2="530"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="#6b7280">
    <circle cx="628" cy="88" r="2.5"/>
    <circle cx="684" cy="245" r="2.5"/>
    <circle cx="580" cy="386" r="2.5"/>
    <circle cx="540" cy="530" r="2.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- footer note -->
  <text x="500" y="630" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="12.5" fill="#6b7280">Exploded view · components separated along the assembly axis · not to scale</text>
</svg>
